implemented.contacts: Block preserves friendship and shared-group/history ACL; both directions reject new direct commit/media binding; unblock retires old grants and restores only still-current friendship; delete removes both contacts and requires a fresh independent accepted request; no permanent reopen prerequisite; bounded new-pending rate and duplicate guard.
implemented.reports: Independent report_evidence stable eight-field uploads, actual image/video classification, owner/purpose/floor checks, atomic explicit evidence/message-version references, own/admin detail and reporter/target filters, report-bound authenticated bytes, fresh source authorization and unavailable projections; old report four-field digest compatible; MFA disposition unchanged.
implemented.username: PATCH /api/me/username with expectedUsername/requestId; stable userId/device/family/epoch, atomic canonical uniqueness/new-and-old reservations, current authoritative user and original-operation current flag; original four auth/profile flows retained.
implemented.retraction: Optional original requestId/expectedVersion on DELETE; nondeleted changed snapshot returns409, already-deleted same-object replay succeeds, old empty body and retract:id remain.

contract.reasonMinimum: TrimSpace then at least1 Unicode rune; full original text counts toward max1000
contract.privacy: User explicitly selects materials; includesWholeConversation=false; unavailable strips body and URL; private,no-store bytes and current ACL on every GET.

newTests.note: No Go test invocation; no skip is counted as pass. Video PG case uses explicitly synthetic container metadata and real upload bytes, not camera capture/playback proof.

deferredVerification: Go compile/typecheck/vet and both pure tests
Six new isolated-PG tests plus affected backend regression
Three updated real HTTP scripts against a newly isolated current-source service
Real iOS report media upload/selected source reads and official Web admin authenticated preview
limitations: Current disk below4GiB gate: compilation, PostgreSQL integration and deployment not executed. Prior report successes do not validate this source.

Username daily change retires the old current login name but preserves occupancy. Disaster recovery may restore an old profile/login name according to confirmed profile RPO/snapshot; stable userId/occupancy remain, and current-epoch reauthentication is required. Existing reserve_username journal protects name occupancy, not latest-name nonrollback; isolated restore verification remains outstanding.
Previously removed relations from older block semantics are not blindly reconstructed; no inferred automatic friendship restoration.
Legacy conversation-target reports have no fabricated targetUserId; old message-target reports without that stored field are not falsely assigned an unverified target.
